checks.name: minimum curve: exact anchors, continuity and monotonicity
12m applies to a whole house, not each voxel
existing houses get priority and cannot silently stay below 12m
new houses with sites smaller than 12m are not generated
compact fragments respect curve, source uplift and narrow-site bounds
fine/coarse transitions use actual cell metres including 25m boundary
single-voxel exceptions stay a small minority of minimum houses
same input is deterministic, and old cache revisions are rejected
default candidate uses current code and has no unresolved existing houses
all size-slider positions enforce minimum or explicitly block publication
minimum volume uplift is explicit and split bookkeeping balances
protected buildings and untouched source assemblies retain their protection
new and expanded house envelopes introduce no overlaps
all reserved parcels stay under the additional 15 percent limit
all four LOD meshes use correct house parts and fixed outer dimensions
source landscape, saved scene and manuscript remain unchanged
